description: This Java class is a service implementation for managing account number formats within the Fineract project. It provides methods for creating, updating, and deleting account number format entities, with transaction management and data validation. It handles data integrity exceptions and logs errors appropriately.

classes.name: AccountNumberFormatWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing account number format operations with create, update, and delete functionalities and exception handling.

methods.name: createAccountNumberFormat
methods.description: Creates a new account number format entity after validating input data, handling data integrity exceptions.

methods.name: updateAccountNumberFormat
methods.description: Updates an existing account number format entity with new prefix type and prefix character values, saving changes with validation.

methods.name: deleteAccountNumberFormat
methods.description: Deletes an account number format entity by its ID.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles exceptions related to data integrity violations, throws specific exceptions based on the cause.
